[[File:Council_of_Elders_Palace_LoNH.png|thumb|right|250px|The Council of the Elders' palace]]
The '''Council of Elders's palace''' was the site that housed the [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|ruling council]] of the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]]. It was built near the [[Fountain of Ancients]] in the [[Derelkoos Desert]] of [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
